relationships.name: Leads objective (Meta / Paid Social)
relationships.difference: Both are lead-generation campaign objectives, but Meta only documents that Leads is a supported objective for image ads and that objective choice controls available placements and calls to action; it does not document Meta's event taxonomy or bidding, so equivalence beyond 'lead-generation objective exists on both platforms' cannot be claimed.
relationships.context: Marketer choosing a paid-social objective for sign-up or lead generation campaigns.

evidence.locator: Leads is listed as a supported objective for image ads; selecting an objective determines which placements and calls to action are available.

relationships.name: Lead Generation objective (Search Ads) (TikTok)
relationships.difference: TikTok offers Lead Generation as an objective for its Search Ads Campaign (setup can start with it pre-selected), which is search-driven inventory, whereas Pinterest Leads is a non-transactional conversion objective in Ads Manager campaigns, not a search campaign type.
relationships.context: Marketer deciding where to run lead generation across platforms.

evidence.locator: Lead Generation is a supported campaign objective for the Search Ads Campaign; setup can start with the Lead Generation objective pre-selected and Search campaign selected.
evidence.source_title: Set up a Search Ads Campaign
